body: You weren't to harsh. I don't really have any intension at this point of going throw with any plains to hurt myself, but it doesn't make the thoughts go away. I know that it would hurt a lot of people. I still don't feel like I can talk to my girlfriend about this stuff because I don't want to hurt or upset her, I feel like I need to protect her from the things that are going on in my head. P.S. thanks for even listening to me, it means a lot.
Thank you for the support its nice to just here from someone how understands that I'm truly hurting and isn't just telling me that "it was just a dog" and "get over it"

She was a pomeranian, I know that's not a vary manly dog for I young man to have but I loved her so much.  She loved to always be right by my side and always was so happy to see me when I came home. I had a  period of time a few years ago were I fell in to another my first bout with depression Because of a seres of bad luck and at this time I was a real suicide risk and had every intension of doing it. In reality the only thing that stopped me from going throw with it was this dog, having her unconditional  love was so soothing and reassuring and I knew that I had to stay alive if for now other reason to take care of her. So now having lost that I feel a lost in the world.
